title: PBMC Isolation Protocol from Whole Blood
author: Adil R. Sarhan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bnhxmb7n
materials: Immediately snap freeze samples in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Collect whole blood
steps.instruction: Collect three 6 mL samples of whole blood into BD Vacutainer sodium‑heparin 6 mL tubes (green BD Hemogard Closure, cat# 367876) and gently invert each tube 8–10 times.

steps.title: Add Ficoll to SepMate
steps.instruction: Using a 20 mL syringe with a ≥21 G large‑bore needle, carefully add 15 mL Ficoll‑Paque PREMIUM into a SepMate™ tube (STEMCELL, cat# 85450, 50 mL capacity) through the central hole of the insert; dispose of the needle appropriately. The Ficoll will sit above the insert (small bubbles are acceptable).

steps.title: Dilute blood with PBS‑FBS
steps.instruction: Transfer 15 mL of the heparinized blood from the collection tubes into a 50 mL Falcon tube with a 5 mL pipette, add 15 mL PBS containing 2 % FBS (1:1 dilution), and mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Layer diluted blood onto Ficoll
steps.instruction: Hold the SepMate™ tube vertically and slowly add the diluted blood down the side of the tube with a pipette, avoiding direct flow through the central hole of the insert.

steps.title: Centrifuge SepMate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the SepMate™ tube at 1 200 × g, room temperature, 10 min, brake ON.

steps.title: Remove plasma layer
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, carefully pipette off the transparent plasma layer and discard it appropriately.

steps.title: Collect PBMC layer
steps.instruction: Using a new pipette, collect the opaque layer above the insert (containing PBMCs) into a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash PBMCs
steps.instruction: Top up the tube to 15 mL with PBS + 2 % FBS and mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: First PBMC spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1 000 × g, room temperature, 2 min, brake ON to pellet the PBMCs.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the PBMC pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet (wash 1)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL PBS + 2 % FBS.

steps.title: Second PBMC spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1 000 × g, room temperature, 2 min, brake ON to pellet the PBMCs again.

steps.title: Thaw MLi‑2 stock
steps.instruction: During the centrifugation in the previous step, retrieve the MLi‑2 inhibitor stock (200 µM, 1000×) from the –80 °C freezer and let it thaw at room temperature for later use (steps 19 and 21).

steps.title: Discard supernatant (second wash)
steps.instruction: Immediately after the second spin, discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet (wash 2)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the PBMC pellet in 10 mL PBS + 2 % FBS by gently pipetting up and down four times.

steps.title: Aliquot cells
steps.instruction: Divide the suspension equally into two 5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Label tubes
steps.instruction: Label one tube “DMSO” and the other “MLi‑2”.

steps.title: Add DMSO to control
steps.instruction: To the “DMSO” tube add 5 µL DMSO and mix gently by pipetting up and down two times with a 10 mL pipette.

steps.title: Add MLi‑2 inhibitor
steps.instruction: To the “MLi‑2” tube add 5 µL of the 200 µM MLi‑2 stock (final concentration 200 nM) and mix gently by pipetting up and down two times with a 10 mL pipette.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Incubate both tubes for 30 min at room temperature, inverting gently every 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare reagents
steps.instruction: Retrieve 0.5 M DIFP stock from –80 °C and keep on ice in the fume hood; retrieve 1 mg/mL microcystin‑LR stock from –80 °C and thaw at room temperature; defrost 0.5 mL lysis buffer at room temperature then keep on ice; prepare 1 mL PBS + 2 % FBS containing 1 µL DMSO (call this “DMSO Resuspension Buffer”); prepare 1 mL PBS + 2 % FBS containing 1 µL 200 µM MLi‑2 stock (call this “MLi‑2 Resuspension Buffer”).

steps.title: Pellet cells after incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge both tubes at 335 × g, room temperature, 5 min, using acceleration and deceleration settings of 5 on a Beckman Coulter Allegra X‑15R (max 10).

steps.title: Discard post‑incubation supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant from each tube without disturbing the pellets.

steps.title: Resuspend in DMSO buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the “DMSO Resuspension Buffer” (1 mL) and transfer to an Eppendorf tube labeled “DMSO”.

steps.title: Resuspend in MLi‑2 buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the “MLi‑2 Resuspension Buffer” (1 mL) and transfer to an Eppendorf tube labeled “MLi‑2”.

steps.title: Low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge both Eppendorf tubes at 300 × g, room temperature, 3 min.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, add 0.5 µL 0.5 M DIFP and 0.5 µL 1 mg/mL microcystin‑LR to 0.5 mL lysis buffer, mix, and keep on ice (use within 15 min of cell lysis).

steps.title: Discard supernatant after low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Immediately after the 300 × g spin, discard the supernatant from each tube, leaving the pellets on ice.

steps.title: Lyse DMSO sample
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL DIFP‑containing lysis buffer to the “DMSO” tube and resuspend the pellet by pipetting up and down 5–10 times with a 100–200 µL pipette.

steps.title: Lyse MLi‑2 sample
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL DIFP‑containing lysis buffer to the “MLi‑2” tube and resuspend the pellet by pipetting up and down 5–10 times with a 100–200 µL pipette.

steps.title: Clarify lysates
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysates on ice for 10 min, then centrifuge at 14 000 rpm, 4 °C, 15 min to pellet debris.

steps.title: Collect supernatants
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatants (containing PBMC lysates) to new Eppendorf tubes and discard the debris pellets.

steps.title: Store lysates
steps.instruction: Store the lysate samples at –80 °C until further use or shipment on dry ice, keeping them frozen at all times.
